about me

The Developer
Behind the Code

I'm a Python backend developer based in Delhi, India, currently pursuing my BCA from IILM University, Noida. I have hands-on experience building and deploying REST API-driven applications from the ground up.

I've delivered 4 end-to-end Python projects including a live cloud storage platform with session management and RBAC, a machine learning threat detection pipeline, and database-backed desktop applications.

I believe in building software that is modular, testable, and production-ready — covering the full SDLC from schema design to deployment. I gather peer feedback and iterate through each release cycle.

I'm seeking a backend engineering role where I can contribute to a collaborative team building scalable systems.

Cloud File Storage System

Attendance Management System
Python desktop application managing 200+ student records with full CRUD operations across 4 dedicated UI screens. Optimised parameterised SQL queries filterable by date, subject, and student ID — generating summary reports in a single database query.

Cyber Security Threat Detection
ML threat detection pipeline combining Isolation Forest anomaly detection with rule-based blacklist matching. Processed and analysed 1,000+ network log entries using Pandas/NumPy with Matplotlib threat score visualisations.

Python desktop application with complete end-to-end booking pipeline — seat selection, conflict detection, confirmation, and atomic SQLite transaction. Handles concurrent seat requests without double-booking in a clean 3-step workflow.
